name: eur_trip_card_vs_fx
title: EUR Trip Card Versus FX
prompt: read_file trip_budget.csv, bot_rates.tsv, card_terms.txt, rate_guide.md. gross = EUR_amount * EUR_spot_sell. EUR wallet net = gross * (1 - 0.005). CARD net = gross * (1 + 0.025). Cheaper = lower net; savings = |diff| with exactly two digits after the decimal point. Submit 'EUR by N.NN' or 'CARD by N.NN' via submit.

rate_guide.md: BOT spot_sell is used when the bank sells non-cash foreign currency to the customer. For this task, both options use EUR spot_sell before applying cashback or card fees.
card_terms.txt: Foreign transaction fee: 2.5% of converted TWD purchase amount. EUR wallet cashback: 0.5%. TWD/USD card path cashback: none. Report the cheaper option by the difference between net costs.
